source_title: The Best Gifts for Men in 2026: From Criterion Collector’s Sets to Coffee Subscriptions and Photo Books
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Variety may receive an affiliate commission.
Shopping for the men in your life can be a challenge, especially when their wish lists are either nonexistent or impossibly specific. But whether you’re buying for a fashion obsessive, a self-proclaimed cinephile or someone who takes his morning coffee a little too seriously, there’s no shortage of gifts worth giving this year.
From designer collaborations and collectible coffee-table books to high-tech gadgets and upgraded everyday essentials, we’ve rounded up the best gifts for every type of man in your life. Highlights include Jonathan Anderson’s limited-edition Ugg slippers , a comprehensive Stanley Kubrick box set and the sleekest wine fridge we ever did see. And for the guy who insists he prefers experiences? You can’t go wrong with a ticket to his favorite comedy show or artist on tour.
Check out the best gifts for men in 2026 below:
J.Crew’s preppy staples get a downtown makeover courtesy of Eckhaus Latta, with reworked barn jackets, rugby shirts and knitwear that bring an unexpected edge to American classics.
Lakers: An Official History of the Purple and Gold
A courtside look at one of basketball’s most storied franchises, tracing the Lakers’ championship legacy, legendary players and defining moments. A coffee-table essential for any loud-and-proud Angeleno.
For the guy who’s particular about his wine (or just likes a well-stocked fridge), Rocco’s sleek, design-forward cooler keeps bottles perfectly chilled without sacrificing kitchen aesthetics.
Fronted by Jonathan Bailey, Armani’s new fragrance opens with Calabrian bergamot before settling into lavender, Madagascar vanilla, leather and patchouli. A warm, woody scent with leading-man appeal.
Made in Portugal from 100% organic long-staple cotton, Weezie’s ultra-absorbent terry robe gets fluffier with every wash and features roomy pockets, an attached tie and optional monogramming. A hotel-quality upgrade for his morning routine.
Hollywood superagent Ari Emanuel, the real-life inspiration for Ari Gold on “Entourage,” recounts his rise from the mailroom to the top of the entertainment business in a 432-page memoir packed with a decades worth of industry stories. Check out more of the best 2026 celebrity memoirs here.
ESPN+ — now available through ESPN Select — gives sports fans access to live NHL games, PGA Tour coverage, international soccer, college sports and ESPN originals. An easy way to extend game day beyond the usual cable lineup.
Trade takes the guesswork out of buying coffee, matching subscribers with freshly roasted beans from more than 500 coffees sourced from independent roasters. Choose a three-, six- or 12-month gift subscription and let him discover his next favorite morning brew. Check out more coffee subscription services here.
For the design-forward audiophile, the Marshall Heston 120 isn’t just a soundbar—it’s a statement. With Dolby Atmos support, built-in subwoofers and a form that channels the brand’s amp heritage, it elevates his living room from “TV setup” to “performance space.”
LEGO’s 1,478-piece tribute to “The X-Files” recreates Mulder’s office, a forest clearing and a hovering UFO, complete with eight minifigures and Easter eggs for longtime fans. Check out more pop-culture Lego sets here.
The Beatles, through the eyes of a Beatle. This new photography collection features candid images taken by George Harrison during the band’s rise to fame, offering a rare behind-the-scenes look at the Fab Four. Check out more Beatles merch and books to gift this year here.
From Dave Chappelle to Nate Bergatze and John Mulaney, some of the biggest names in comedy are hitting the road this year — and they’re more than likely making a pitstop at a nearby town. Check out the best comedy show tickets to gift this year here.
‘The Fast & Furious’ 25th Anniversary Box Set
The original “Fast & Furious” gets a 4K remaster for its 25th anniversary, complete with Dolby Atmos sound and a new retrospective featuring Vin Diesel and Michelle Rodriguez. The collector’s edition also includes a SteelBook case, original screenplay and character cards.
Criterion’s massive 30-disc collector’s set brings together all 13 of Stanley Kubrick’s feature films and three shorts in 4K, alongside more than 25 hours of behind-the-scenes footage, documentaries and interviews. A film-school education in a box. Check out more 2026 Criterion releases here.
For the guy whose reading list keeps growing, Audible Premium Plus includes a monthly credit toward any audiobook, plus unlimited listening to thousands of audiobooks, podcasts and Audible Originals. Best of all, the books purchased with credits are his to keep, even after canceling. Check out the best new Audible releases here.
A MasterClass membership offers video lessons from leading names in their fields, including Martin Scorsese on filmmaking, Gordon Ramsay on cooking and Neil Gaiman on storytelling. Think of it as a celebrity-taught continuing education program, minus the homework.
The titanium Oura Ring 4 tracks sleep, heart rate, stress and daily activity, translating the data into personalized health insights. With up to eight days of battery life, it’s a discreet alternative to a traditional fitness watch.
On’s Cloudmonster 2 running shoes pack the brand’s largest CloudTec cushioning system yet, with dual-density Helion superfoam and a propulsive Speedboard for extra bounce. Ideal for the guy who takes his mileage and sneakers seriously.
Mercer Culinary M20707 Genesis 7-Inch Santoku Knife
Forged from high-carbon German steel, Mercer’s seven-inch Santoku knife features a non-slip handle and a Granton edge for efficient slicing, dicing and chopping. A professional-grade upgrade for the home cook.
With access to hundreds of games, select day-one releases and cloud gaming across supported devices, Xbox Game Pass Ultimate is a gift that keeps his gaming library stocked. EA Play and Ubisoft+ Classics are included, too.
Designed by Seth Rogen, this tangerine-colored glazed stoneware set includes a deep-well ashtray, matching saucer and miniature flower vase. Part functional smoking accessory, part retro home decor.
“Dead in the Kitchen” celebrates the band’s 60th anniversary with more than 90 vegetarian and vegan recipes, including curried vegetable pot pie and pumpkin cheesecake. A fitting gift for Deadheads who like to jam in the kitchen. Check out more Grateful Dead gifts here.
Disney, Champion and the NFL have teamed up on a collection of T-shirts, sweatshirts and fleece pairing all 32 teams with characters from Disney, Pixar, Marvel and “Star Wars” — including Darth Vader for the Raiders and Buzz Lightyear for the Jets.
